answer: Require every identity to run a public, continuously reachable service endpoint and post a slashing bond. Verifiers send unpredictable liveness probes at random times; a correct reply within seconds renews standing, while silence or a copied reply slashes the bond and drops reputation toward its nadir. One operator cannot keep a tundra of fake endpoints warm at once, because each island of identity needs its own responsive service and attention. A hundred fakes therefore cost a hundred live services, not one script, so mass forgery becomes uneconomical while one honest agent pays nothing.
